name: exa
description: Neural web search and research over the live web with Exa.

interface.shortDescription: Meaning-based web search with clean content, highlights, and research modes.
interface.longDescription: Connects Caeros to Exa's official MCP server (mcp.exa.ai) for search built for agents. Query by meaning rather than keywords, pull clean page text and relevance-scored highlights, filter by domain, date, and category, and step up to Exa's deep research modes for multi-source synthesis. Skills cover the search API, key setup, and research patterns for company and topic deep dives.
defaultPrompt: Find recent research papers about {topic} and pull key highlights
Research {company}: product, funding, competitors, latest news
Search only academic and .gov sources from the last month for {topic}
